B.text:
def test_unwind_inner_wrapper_teardown_exc() -> None:
    out = []

    @hookimpl(wrapper=True)
    def m1():
        out.append("m1 init")
        try:
            yield
            out.append("m1 unreachable")  # pragma: no cover
        except BaseException:
            out.append("m1 teardown")
            raise
        finally:
            out.append("m1 cleanup")

    @hookimpl(wrapper=True)
    def m2():
        out.append("m2 init")
        yield
        out.append("m2 raise")
        raise ValueError()

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        try:
            MC([m2, m1], {})
        finally:
            out.append("finally")

    assert out == [
        "m1 init",
        "m2 init",
        "m2 raise",
        "m1 teardown",
        "m1 cleanup",
        "finally",
    ]
